identity.title: Sun, Moon, Ultra Sun & Ultra Moon arc (Adventures)

leadText:
The Sun, Moon, Ultra Sun & Ultra Moon arc (Japanese: 第十四章　サン・ムーン・ウルトラサン・ウルトラムーン編 The Fourteenth Chapter: Sun, Moon, Ultra Sun & Ultra Moon arc), originally published in magazines as the Sun & Moon arc (Japanese: サン・ムーン編 Sun & Moon arc), is the fourteenth story arc of the Pokémon Adventures . It began serialization in November 2016, and ended in November 2019.

The arc follows the adventures of , a courier that aims to gather 100 million yen for a classified purpose, and , a pharmacist from Sinnoh who traveled to Alola to deliver a to Professor Kukui. When the Tapu start to get angry for some reason, the island kahunas choose to resurrect the old tradition of the island challenge in the hopes of appeasing them, with Sun getting chosen to carry out this task. Meanwhile, the threat of an Ultra Beast invasion looms over the region due to the actions of Aether Foundation President Lusamine and Team Skull Boss Guzma. Branch Chief Faba is determined to use this opportunity to take over the Aether Foundation and destroy Lusamine's family to enact a twisted revenge on her for not accepting his lustful feelings towards her.

It began serialization in November 2016, and ended in November 2019.

The arc follows the adventures of , a courier that aims to gather 100 million yen for a classified purpose, and , a pharmacist from Sinnoh who traveled to Alola to deliver a to Professor Kukui. When the Tapu start to get angry for some reason, the island kahunas choose to resurrect the old tradition of the island challenge in the hopes of appeasing them, with Sun getting chosen to carry out this task. Meanwhile, the threat of an Ultra Beast invasion looms over the region due to the actions of Aether Foundation President Lusamine and Team Skull Boss Guzma. Branch Chief Faba is determined to use this opportunity to take over the Aether Foundation and destroy Lusamine's family to enact a twisted revenge on her for not accepting his lustful feelings towards her.

== Terminology ==
 
This arc gets its name from the core series games, Pokémon Sun and Moon and Pokémon Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon.

==Volumes==

===Mini-volumes===
====Japan====
 
As with the two arcs before it, the Sun, Moon, Ultra Sun & Ultra Moon arc was collected separately into mini-volumes. The first volume was released on June 23, 2017, with the final volume released on December 27, 2019.

These volumes have also been localized in English by Shogakukan Asia.

====United States====
 
An English translation of the Sun, Moon, Ultra Sun & Ultra Moon arc was released by VIZ Media under the title Pokémon Sun & Moon, which was released in their own mini-volumes as with the two arcs before it. The first volume was released on May 8, 2018, with the final volume released on January 11, 2022.
